name: Wall of Shadow
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect wall up to 10 ft./levellong and 5 ft./level high (S)
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no (see text)

DESCRIPTION

A vertical curtain of shadow appears. It is 2 feet thick and considerably opaque. It blocks line of sight, and creatures within 5′ of the other side of the wall have concealment (20% miss chance) while creatures beyond 5′ have total concealment (50% miss chance). Passing through the wall results in shadow stuff clinging to the creature or object, and inflicts the entangled condition (spell resistance applies). Entangled creatures can attempt to break free as a move action, making a Strength or Escape Artist check. The DC for this check is equal to the DC of the spell.
